tip.teach: Want me to learn a new move? Click the plus in the action bar.
tip.make-pet: Want another buddy? Click + in the main window and AI will make one for you.
focus.done: Nice work! You stayed focused—take {n} minutes to recharge.
focus.done2: Session nailed! Stretch a little and enjoy a {n}-minute break.
focus.done3: Well done! Grab some water and rest for {n} minutes—I'll be right here.
focus.done4: Another session in the bag! Give your eyes a {n}-minute breather.
focus.doneLong: Awesome streak—{round} sessions in a row! Take a proper {n}-minute break.
focus.rested: Recharged and ready? Break's over—shall we start the next session?
focus.rested2: Feeling refreshed? Ready to dive into another focus round?
focus.rested3: Break's up! Take a deep breath—I'm here whenever you're ready to go.
focus.rested4: Nice breather! Ready to keep the momentum going?
focus.title: Focus
focus.petTint: Clock light takes the pet's color
focus.doneAway: That session finished while you were away. Take {n} minutes off.
focus.autoNext: Start the next session after a break
focus.autoNextNote: Break's over — starting the next session.
skills.focus.name: Focus with me
skills.focus.how: Right-click it and pick “{item}”: a clock appears and it works alongside you
tip.focus: Need to focus? Right-click me and pick “Focus with me”. I'll keep you company.
demo.focus.step2: The clock runs above it while it works too
demo.focus.step3: When time's up, celebrate together and take a break
phone.cannotStart: Couldn't start file transfer. Try again in a moment.
phone.sendNone: The chosen files are no longer there.
phone.zipTooBig: These files are too big together. Download them one by one.
phone.tooBig: “{name}” is over the {max} GB limit in settings.
phone.notAccepted: Not accepted on the computer yet.
phone.page.title: File transfer · {pet}
phone.page.offline: {pet} ended file transfer. On the computer, choose “File transfer” again.
phone.page.textPlaceholder: Paste or type some text or a link
phone.page.waitingHint: Choose “Accept” on the computer to start
phone.page.deskEmpty: On the computer, open the files on {pet}, pick some and choose “Send to phone”. They show up here.
phone.page.saveHint: Press and hold a picture to save it to your phone
phone.page.keepIos: Photos: tap to open, then press and hold and choose “Save to Photos”. Other files: tap “Download” and they go to the Files app. “Download all” makes one zip file; tap it in Files to unpack.
phone.page.keep: Tap “Download” to save to your phone's downloads. Photos can also be saved by pressing and holding.
phone.menu.show: Show the file transfer QR code
phone.scan: Scan with your phone's camera. Phone and computer need the same Wi‑Fi.
phone.scanMore: Other phones can scan this code too. Closing the bubble keeps the transfer going.
phone.firewallMac: The first time, macOS may ask whether Sidekin may accept incoming connections. Choose Allow.
phone.firewallWin: The first time, a firewall prompt appears. Tick Private networks and choose Allow.
phone.help.wifi: Put both on the same Wi‑Fi, not a guest or public network: those often keep devices apart.
phone.help.firewallMac: In System Settings › Network › Firewall, let Sidekin accept incoming connections.
phone.help.firewallWin: If the firewall prompt was cancelled, tick Sidekin in Windows Security › Firewall & network protection › Allow an app through firewall.
phone.help.hotspot: If nothing works, connect the computer to the phone's hotspot and scan again.
phone.settings.title: File transfer
phone.settings.note: With both on the same Wi‑Fi, right-click the pet, choose “File transfer” and scan the code with your phone’s camera.
phone.settings.folder: Files from the phone are saved in
phone.settings.discard.trashWin: Delete it too (move to Recycle Bin)
phone.settings.discardNote: Only for files from the phone. Files you dragged onto the pet yourself are never touched.
phone.settings.trustedNone: None yet. Choose “Always accept from this phone” when one sends, and it is added here.
phone.settings.renewNote: The old code stops working at once; every phone needs to scan again.
phone.settings.renewed: Done. Scan the new code next time.
skills.phone.name: File transfer
skills.phone.how: Right-click it, choose “{item}” and scan the code with your phone’s camera to transfer photos, files and text between phone and computer
tip.phone: Need to transfer things between phone and computer? Right-click me, choose “File transfer” and scan.
demo.phone.step2: Scan with the phone, pick photos, send
demo.phone.step3: Choose “Accept” and the photos fly to it
phone.noNetwork: The computer isn't on Wi‑Fi or a cable yet. The code appears by itself once it is.
host.replaceProtected: This action stays unchanged. Only the six supported base actions and ordinary one-shot actions can be edited.
host.replaceExplicit: Use the edit-action workflow to replace a base action.
host.replaceOnly: An edit-action package may only change its selected actions, not trigger rules.
host.replaceTiming: Keep the original frame count and playback timing.
host.replaceStale: The reference action version has changed. Copy a fresh edit instruction and try again.
studio.editHint: Copy this to your AI and describe your change. It comes back as a draft to preview and accept.
studio.editAsk: Edit action “{label}” (action ID {action}) for “{name}” (pet ID {id}). Follow the skill’s edit-existing-action workflow: export the currently accepted action and identity references and attach them to the image-generation request. Preserve appearance, proportions, purpose and playback timing. Deliver a draft for review. My change:
studio.restoreActionNote: Restore the action shipped with your pet. Its triggers stay in place, and this version stays in Saved actions.
studio.replacementNote: Replace the animation for “{label}” wherever it is used. Its purpose and trigger rules stay the same.
archive.title: Saved actions
archive.note: Every received action is kept here. Choosing one only changes this action; its triggers stay in place.
archive.deleteNote: This saved action will be removed. Your current action and any shared images stay in place.
archive.switchFirst: This action is in use. Choose another one before deleting it.
archive.missing: This saved action no longer exists.
archive.selected: Action selected. Existing triggers stay in place.
archive.kept: Kept in Saved actions. You can choose it later.
archive.saved: Both current and previous actions are saved.
todo.title: To-dos
todo.note: Jot down what to do. The pet reminds you at the time, and you can start a focus session on any of them.
todo.empty: Nothing for today. Jot one down?
todo.tasksNote: Things the companion brain does for you on a schedule. They run only while the brain is on.
todo.focusOn: This tomato went to (tick it when done):
host.planTime: Write the time as HH:MM, like 09:30
host.ruleNotPlan: Rule {id}: a learned action can only play on a double-click, at random, or at a time each day (optionally weekdays only), one learned action at a time
act.doubleTaken: Double-click now plays “{label}”; turning this on moves it here
act.doubleOld: Double-click now has an earlier rule; turning this on replaces it
act.planNone: Not scheduled yet; use the settings key
act.oldLead: Learned actions now play on double-click, now and then, or at a time each day. These were taught before and still run; remove any you don't want.
act.learnedEmpty: Nothing learned yet. Use the plus in the action bar.
act.sleepLead: Left alone for a while, the pet naps; click it to wake it.
studio.restoreBaseLead: {list} go back to how the pet was made. The redrawn ones stay in Saved actions.
host.planRandom: That is not a valid frequency
focus.statsNote: How long you focused each day, and on what. To start: right-click the pet and choose “{item}”.
memory.addOne: Add one yourself, then press Return
studio.exportInApp: Export pet packs in the desktop app.
todo.dragHint: Drag the ⋮⋮ on the left to set the order, or drag one from Later into Today.
todo.laterEmpty: Things without a day go here.
todo.aiTidyLead: {n} found. Untick any you don't want:
todo.aiReplaceNote: The original goes; you can undo
skills.todo.name: To-dos
skills.todo.how: Right-click it and choose “{item}”. Write one line, like “report at 3pm tomorrow”, and it reminds you on time
skills.todo.tips:
Drag the ⋮⋮ on the left to set the order, or into Today
Double-click a title to edit it
Right-click one to break it down
Paste a paragraph and choose “Turn into to-dos”
Breaking down and turning into to-dos need the companion brain on
skills.panel.tips:
Topics are grouped by day, each with the face of the pet you talked to
Translations are at the bottom of the list
skills.menu-translate.tips: Under Translate in the right-click menu you can also explain, polish, summarize, and open past translations
skills.focus.tips: The Focus page shows how long you focused today, this week and this month, and on which to-dos
skills.memory.tips:
On the Memory page, “About you” is where you tell it about yourself
What it remembered is there too, to edit or delete
skills.teach.tips: A learned action has a settings key in its corner: play it on double-click, at random, or at a time each day
skills.make-pet.tips: Double-click the name at the top of the pet page to rename it, or right-click it in the pet list
skills.menu.tips:
To-dos and Focus come first in the right-click menu
While focusing, pause and give up come first
todo.aiTidyHint: The companion reads it, picks out what you need to do, and you choose which to add
tip.todo: Something to remember? Right-click me and pick “To-dos”. One line is enough, and I'll remind you on time.
home.move: Drag, or use the up and down arrow keys, to move “{name}”
home.memoryEmpty: Nothing yet. Chat a bit and it will note things about you, or write them yourself.
home.cardsHint: Drag ⋮⋮ to reorder. Shared by all pets.
persona.title: {name}'s personality
persona.sub: Only {name}'s. It reads this before every reply.
persona.tip: Say how it talks and what it does, not just adjectives. Sections help.

onboard.makePetTip: Want your own custom pet? Click + in the main window anytime with a photo or a short description.

skills.clipboard.tips:
Pin items you reuse so new copies won't push them out
Everything stays on your computer, and password managers are skipped
Browse and manage your history anytime in the Memory page
